items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: I had the good fortune of being on his staff along with Billy May

ctx.x: Following that time then, you played again off and on for a couple of years -- '43 and '44 -- in Fletcher's band, and then I note here that you reformed your group -- smaller group, and from time to time you were

Yes. Along that era, I believe I was doing quite a bit of arranging for Charley Barnet and his great band, you know, and Billy May was in that band, the great arranger and trumpet player. Course Charley had some great guys that could play, and of course, I think that Cliff Leeman, drum --
